// Prior shape of a wording RED test: it read an old revision through git.
import { execFileSync } from "node:child_process";

function gitShow(revPath: string): string {
  return execFileSync("git", ["show", revPath], { encoding: "utf8" });
}

const oldCore = gitShow("7f9412c:spec/draft-dogru-cedulon-core-05.md");
void oldCore;
